Name: Joja Storage Room (PIF)
Author: cryomancer199x
Description:
PIF is a cool mod and I've been wanting to dip into it a bit. So here's one I made up awhile ago finally cleaned up and ready.

This is a basic storage/shed type room, with Joja theming. It upgrades alongside your house. Three versions, each with a bit more features.

tier 0 - nothing special
tier 1 - drink machine
tier 2 -drink machine, jukebox, joja store access, and a wall spot you can decorate

Also included are two new PIF doors in the door store. 

Nothing too fancy, enjoy.

Downloads.Description: Store some store stuff. Requires PIF.
